title: Scoped dynamic sales-order report preview
description: User scene: an authorized salesperson selects sales-order fields and bounded filters to preview only orders in their ERP data scope. Reuse the existing sales-order menu permission and SalespersonDataScopeService; deny missing role, scope, or invalid field/filter, and return a bounded error without data leakage. Read-only queries use the existing request audit trail; no direct SQL from a model or new privilege. Development-only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible operation, secret/.env change, or deployment. Verify with unit tests and the safe build/test profile.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated GET returns a finite allowlisted sales-order field catalog; POST rejects unknown fields, invalid date ranges, excessive page size and missing sales-order permission before querying.
Preview filters order date, customer, status and currency within the current user's SalespersonDataScopeService scope, with stable paging capped at 200 and no writes or arbitrary SQL.
Tests cover selected columns, filters, paging, unauthorized and out-of-scope users, invalid input and no writes; document the request audit and data boundaries.
